title: Distance preserved by binary encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, and let $w,w_0$ be Boolean strings of length $n$. Encode each bit as the corresponding element of $\\mathbb F_2$ coordinate by coordinate. The relative Hamming distance between the encoded strings equals the relative Hamming distance between the original strings.
